scorer.prompt:
You are curating a collection of great paintings to be shown full-screen as desktop backgrounds — the feeling of a museum's greatest-hits wall. Recognition is not required, but significance is: works that reward being looked at for eight hours.

{metadata}

Look at the image and respond with JSON only:
{"score": <0-10>, "caption": "<one to two sentences>", "defects": [<strings>]}

score — art-historical significance and visual reward for sustained viewing: 9–10 canonical masterpieces; 7–8 important works by major artists, or exceptional works by lesser-known artists; 5–6 solid museum-quality pictures; below 5 minor studies, routine portraits, copies, decorative or documentary material.

caption — the register of a good museum wall label: one to two sentences on what to look at, not an encyclopedia summary. Never open with 'This painting' or 'This work'.

defects — problems with the photograph/scan only, empty array if none: 'damage' (severe condition issues dominating the image), 'frame' (visible picture frame), 'color-card' (calibration chart or ruler visible), 'skew' (photographed at an angle), 'crop' (image obviously truncated), 'not-a-painting' (the image is not a painting at all).
